title: Orbit setup texts
description: Every string `orbit setup` writes into an assistant's files: the managed instruction block, the two hook nudges, the MCP server entry, and the values filling {{name}} placeholders in assistant templates. Read by crates/orbit-cli/src/commands/setup/spec.rs.

name.description: Key of the MCP server entry written into each assistant's MCP config.

command.description: Whitespace-separated stdio command. `{{orbit}}` resolves to the launcher.

mcp_server.description: The one stdio MCP server every assistant with an `mcp` block registers.

instructions.description: Markdown spliced into each assistant's instruction file between the orbit:setup markers.

nudge_search.description: Context the hook guard returns for a search tool call.

nudge_read.description: Context the hook guard returns for a source-file read.

template_vars.description: Values substituted for {{name}} placeholders in the templates assistants declare. They reach a shell echo, so they must not contain quotes, backticks, or $(.
